title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DESIGNATING THE CABINET SECRETARY AS THE OVERSIGHT OFFICIAL ON MATTERS PERTAINING TO THE INDIGENOUS PEOPLES AND NATIONAL COMMISSION ON INDIGENOUS PEOPLES

text.en:
The Cabinet Secretary is hereby designated as the Oversight
Official on IPs and NIP matters to coordinate the implementation of the policies
and programs impacting on the promotion and protection of the rights and
welfare of the IPs in the country, and on the efficient functioning of the NCIP.

As Oversight Official, the Cabinet Secretary shall coordinate
and facilitate the resolution of issues and concerns affecting the IPs and of the
efficient discharge of the duties and functions of the NCIP. In this regard, the
Oversight Official shall submit regular report on the status of his work to the
President, through the Executive Secretary.

All Government Departments and Agencies, including the
Government-Owned and Controlled Corporations, Financial Institutions and other
government instrumentalities are hereby directed to extend their support for the
efficient discharge of the above duties and functions of the Oversight Official.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this /57 day of December , in the year of
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
